title: Chrome for bookkeepers on mac: how to manage client accounts and save time
metaTitle: Chrome for bookkeepers on mac: optimize your browser workflow
description: Learn how to use Chrome for bookkeepers on mac effectively. Organize client tabs, manage passwords, and use voice assistants to handle your daily accounting tasks.
intro: Bookkeepers spend most of their day inside a browser. Using Chrome for bookkeepers on mac requires a system to handle multiple client portals and avoid data entry fatigue. This guide shows you how to organize your digital workspace and use tools like Lazur to speed up your daily tasks.
tldr: Use Chrome profiles to separate client data and avoid login conflicts.
Master keyboard shortcuts to move between tabs without touching your mouse.
Use Lazur to dictate notes or research tax updates while your hands stay on the keyboard.
Clear site data for individual portals when you encounter persistent loading errors.
Pin your most used accounting software tabs to the start of your tab bar.

blocks.text: Managing multiple client portals in Chrome

You likely manage accounts for ten or more clients. Keeping them in one browser window is a recipe for errors. Use Chrome profiles to keep client data separate. Go to the profile icon in the top right corner. Select Add to create a new profile for each client. This keeps cookies and saved passwords isolated. You will never accidentally log into Client A using Client B credentials again.

Your mouse is your enemy when you need speed. Use these shortcuts to move through your day. Press ⌘ + T to open a new tab. Press ⌘ + Option + Right Arrow to switch to the next tab. Use ⌘ + L to jump immediately to the address bar. If you close a tab by mistake, press ⌘ + Shift + T to bring it back instantly. Memorizing these will save you hours of movement over a month.

You often need to check tax rules or software updates while working. Instead of clicking through search results, hold the ⌥ ⌘ keys and ask Lazur. Lazur can look at your current page and summarize complex documentation. If you need to research a new accounting regulation, ask Lazur to find the latest updates. It will open a background tab, read the content, and give you a summary without you leaving your primary task.

Email is where most bookkeepers lose time. You spend about 13 hours a week on it. When you need to reply to a client, hold the fn key to dictate your response. Lazur formats the text for you. This is faster than typing and helps you clear your inbox before your next reconciliation session. For meetings, use the same dictation feature to log action items directly into your task manager while the meeting is still fresh.

Accounting platforms often fail to load data correctly due to cache issues. When a page hangs, do not restart your whole browser. Clear data for that specific site. Click the lock icon in the address bar. Choose Site settings. Select Clear data. This removes the corrupted cache for that domain only. It is a quick fix that saves you from logging back into every other client account.

blocks.text: Many bookkeepers keep too many tabs open. This drains your Mac memory and slows down your machine. Use the Tab Search feature by clicking the arrow in the top right corner of Chrome. If you have more than 20 tabs open, you are likely not using most of them. Close what you do not need. Another mistake is saving passwords in the browser without a master password. Use the built-in Google Password Manager but ensure your Mac is locked whenever you step away from your desk.

faq.question: Can Lazur click buttons in my accounting software?
faq.answer: No. Lazur does not click buttons or operate other apps for you. It points at things on your screen, answers out loud, and helps you get work done by guiding you.

faq.question: How do I move between client tabs faster?
faq.answer: Use the shortcut ⌘ + Option + Right Arrow to cycle through your tabs. You can also pin your most important client tabs by right-clicking the tab and selecting Pin.

faq.question: Does Lazur store my accounting data?
faq.answer: No. Lazur listens and looks at your screen only while you hold the shortcut. Audio and screenshots are sent to AI providers to answer your questions and are not stored. Your content is never used to train AI models.

faq.question: What macOS version do I need for current Chrome?
faq.answer: You need macOS 13 Ventura or later to run the current version of Google Chrome.
